newsitem.title: USA: Dodge City feeder steer prices mixed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Dodge City feeder steer prices mixed - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers 350-500 lbs mostly steady on light offering of Medium and Large 1, compared with last week, USDA said.
Feeder steers 500-700 lbs firm to 1.00 higher; 700-950 lbs steady to 2.00 lower. Feeder heifers 500- 600 lbs steady; 600-850 lbs 1.00-2.00 lower.
Trade and demand moderate. Receipts 55 percent 600 lbs and over; 38 percent 600 lbs and under; 7 percent cows and bulls with 205 early.
Feeder Steers - (Figures in parentheses are weighted average prices) Medium and Large 1 - 550-600 lbs 86.00-88.00 (86.86); 600-650 lbs 85.00; 650-700 lbs 79.00-84.50 (81.88);

800-850 lbs 70.00-72.50 (72.32). Full and/or fleshy 6 head 564 lbs 75.50; 8 head 638 lbs 71.00; 7 head 717 lbs 71.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - 450- 500 lbs 70.00-83.00. Medium 1 - 16 head 640 lbs 74.00; 23 head 685 lbs 70.25.
